Metadata.title: Rajahinta.fi — Finnish Cross-Border Alcohol Price Calculator
Metadata.description: Calculate the true total cost of importing alcohol from abroad to Finland: retail price, transport, excise duty and container tax in one estimate. Free, neutral, and transparent.

SiteFooter.disclaimer: Rajahinta.fi is an independent price comparison and landed-cost calculator. All prices, taxes, and duties are estimates rather than official figures. The service does not provide tax or customs advice. Always verify current details with official sources.
SiteFooter.tagline: Finnish cross-border beverage price index and landed-cost calculator.

Home.subtitle: Finnish cross-border beverage landed-cost calculator
Home.heroHeadline: Calculate the true cost of importing alcohol to Finland
Home.heroSubline: Foreign retail price, transport, and estimates of excise duty and container tax — in one itemized breakdown.
Home.heroPillBadge: Neutral · Transparent · Finnish Tax Administration rates
Home.heroSearchPlaceholder: Search products… e.g. Koskenkorva, IPA, Rioja
Home.heroTrustLine: 🏛 Official tax sources · 📊 Price index · 🔒 WCAG AA accessible
Home.feature1Body: Retail price + transport + excise duty + container deposit — all in one calculation.
Home.feature2Body: Green = verified · Blue = estimated · Amber = stale. Every number carries its reliability status.
Home.feature3Body: No paid placements. All ranking criteria are documented openly and enforced in code.
Home.feature4Body: Historical price and tax-change charts so you can see how costs have moved over time.
Home.heroValueProp: Calculate the total cost of importing alcoholic beverages from abroad to Finland: the foreign retail price, transport, and estimates of alcohol excise duty and container duty.
Home.trustSourcesBody: Product prices are based on datasets published by retailers and on the Alko domestic reference price. Taxes and duties are calculated from the Finnish Tax Administration's official rate datasets.
Home.trustReliabilityBody: Every number shown carries a reliability status and a timestamp, so the certainty and age of the data are always visible.
Home.trustMethodologyBody: The calculation model, the tax sources in use, and the ranking criteria are documented openly.

obligations.heading: Obligations and tax liability
obligations.distanceSellingLiabilityLabel: Tax liability and joint liability (from 1 Sep 2024)

distanceSelling.liability: As a rule, the foreign seller is responsible for Finnish excise duties and for filing the advance notice. If the seller has not paid the duties or filed the advance notice, you are liable for the duties jointly as the buyer. Always make sure the seller provides the transport identifier the Tax Administration requires for the shipment.

distanceBuying.liability: By arranging transport independently, you are solely liable for the excise duties. You must file an advance notice and provide a guarantee in MyTax before the goods are dispatched to Finland. Unnotified goods may be seized by Customs.

travellerImport.liability: No excise duty is payable when the goods are brought in for your personal use within the prescribed traveller import allowances.

obligations.preReformNote: This calculation predates the joint-liability reform effective 1 Sep 2024, so the obligations shown follow the rules in force at that time.

Ranking.title: How ranking works
Ranking.subtitle: Objective, transparent, and free of commercial influence.
Ranking.neutralityStatement: Rajahinta uses only objective, non-commercial factors to sort products. No merchant payment, promotional flag, or manual boost can affect the position of any product.
Ranking.tiebreakerStatement: All sort orders use the product name as a tiebreaker when the primary sort values are equal. Rankings are deterministic: the same data always produces the same order.
Ranking.enforcementP1: The ranking module accepts only a tight input type called NeutralSortInput which contains no field for paid placement, promotional boost, merchant scoring, or any form of manual curation.
Ranking.enforcementP2: Three enforcement layers protect this guarantee:
Ranking.layer1Desc: — the sort function only accepts NeutralSortInput, a tight interface with only the fields needed for sorting.
Ranking.layer2Desc: — a type-level test proves that an object with a paidBoost field is not assignable to NeutralSortInput.
Ranking.layer3Desc: — the sort function rejects any input object with properties not declared on NeutralSortInput, catching accidental data leakage at runtime.
Ranking.spotBody: If you believe a product ranking, calculation, or data point is incorrect, you can flag it for review from the <link>calculator result page</link>. Each result includes a "Flag a problem" affordance that sends your feedback directly to our review team.

Newsletter.title: Newsletter
Newsletter.description: Email notices about rate-dataset changes and service change announcements.
Newsletter.consentLabel: I want to receive the newsletter and consent to my email address being stored to manage the subscription.
Newsletter.separationNote: The newsletter is a separate consent — it is not tied to price alerts or to an account. Every email carries a one-click unsubscribe link, and unsubscribing takes effect immediately.
Newsletter.successBody: The address has been recorded. Open the confirmation link in the email — the subscription activates only after that.
Newsletter.errorRateLimited: Too many attempts — try again in a while.

NewsletterConfirm.title: Newsletter confirmation
NewsletterConfirm.confirmedBody: The newsletter subscription is now active. Every email carries a one-click unsubscribe link.
NewsletterConfirm.endedBody: This address has unsubscribed from the newsletter, and an old link cannot activate it again.
NewsletterConfirm.missingToken: The confirmation link is missing its token.
NewsletterConfirm.invalidBody: The confirmation token is invalid or has already been used.
NewsletterConfirm.invalidHint: If the subscription is still unfinished, subscribe again — a new confirmation email will be sent.
NewsletterConfirm.errorBody: The confirmation failed — try reloading the page.

NewsletterUnsubscribe.title: Newsletter unsubscribe
NewsletterUnsubscribe.doneBody: This email address has been removed from the newsletter list immediately, and no further emails will be sent.
NewsletterUnsubscribe.missingToken: The unsubscribe link is missing its token.
NewsletterUnsubscribe.invalidHint: Check that you opened the link from the email exactly as it was sent.
NewsletterUnsubscribe.errorBody: The unsubscribe failed — try reloading the page.
